scripts.dev:auto: sh -c 'while true; do rm -rf .netlify/functions-serve; netlify dev; echo "[dev:auto] netlify dev exited, restarting in 2s..."; sleep 2; done'
scripts.dev:watchdog: sh -c 'while true; do rm -rf .netlify/functions-serve; netlify dev & pid=$!; fails=0; while kill -0 "$pid" 2>/dev/null; do code=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" "http://localhost:8888/.netlify/functions/list-issues" || true); if [ "$code" = "200" ] || [ "$code" = "401" ] || [ "$code" = "500" ]; then fails=0; else fails=$((fails+1)); fi; if [ "$fails" -ge 3 ]; then echo "[dev:watchdog] health check failed 3x, restarting..."; kill "$pid" 2>/dev/null || true; wait "$pid" 2>/dev/null || true; break; fi; sleep 3; done; echo "[dev:watchdog] netlify exited, restarting in 2s..."; sleep 2; done'
